_meta.unit: % of suffrages exprimés, first round, France entière (metropole + outre-mer + Français de l'étranger where applicable)
_meta.bloc_rule: Each party/list/nuance mapped to exactly one bloc. UNION_GAUCHE holds NUPES (2022) / Union de la gauche-NFP (2024) joint candidacies; when non-null, RADG+GAU+CEN+DRO+EXD+AUT+UNION_GAUCHE sums to ~100.
_meta.udi_choice: UDI/Nouveau Centre/Parti radical/Alliance centriste mapped to DRO whenever they ran allied with UMP/LR (législatives 2007, 2012, 2017, 2022, 2024) and to CEN when they ran autonomous lists (européennes 2014 UDI-MoDem, 2019 Les Européens). 'Écologistes'/ECO nuance (non-Verts ecologists) mapped to AUT except 1997 (combined with Verts) and 2017 (ministry ECO nuance included EELV) where GAU. Sovereigntist right (MPF, RPF/Pasqua, DLR/DLF, UPR, Patriotes, DSV nuance) mapped to EXD per instructions. CPNT mapped to DRO per instructions.

1997.notes: UDF ran jointly with RPR (Union pour la France) but mapped CEN per instructions. 'Écologistes (dont Les Verts)' 6.81 combines Verts with other ecologists (incl. non-left ones like MEI/GE) -> GAU; ambiguous. MDC (Chevènement) included in DVG. MPF/sovereigntist candidates not separated (likely inside DVD) -> DVD in DRO. Table has no separate REG/ECO lines.

2002.notes: UDF ran separately from UMP (Bayrou) -> CEN. MPF and RPF (Pasqua) were in Chirac's majority but mapped EXD as sovereigntist right per instructions (together 1.17); alternative DRO. 'Autres écologistes' (ECO, non-Verts) -> AUT; ambiguous. Pôle républicain (Chevènement) -> GAU.

2007.notes: MoDem (UDF-Mouvement démocrate, Bayrou) -> CEN. Nouveau Centre (2.37) ran allied with UMP in the presidential majority -> DRO (alternative CEN). MPF was listed in 'droite parlementaire' but mapped EXD per instructions. DVG includes MRC. ECO (non-Verts) -> AUT.

2012.notes: Nouveau Centre (2.20), Parti radical valoisien (1.24) and Alliance centriste (0.60) ran allied with UMP (pre-UDI centrists, joint investitures) -> DRO, total 4.04; alternative CEN (instructions list Alliance centriste in CEN). MoDem ran autonomously as 'Le Centre pour la France' -> CEN. ECO (non-EELV ecologists) -> AUT.

2017.notes: LREM (28.21) and MoDem (4.12) shown separately by the ministry; both CEN (Ensemble/majorité présidentielle total 32.33). UDI (3.03) ran under a national agreement with LR -> DRO (alternative CEN). ECO nuance (4.30) in 2017 included EELV candidates -> GAU (it also contains some non-left ecologists). DLF -> EXD.

municipal.explanation: A national first-round aggregate by list nuance exists only for 2014 and 2020 (communes with >=1,000 inhabitants, list ballot; ministry data, reproduced on fr.wikipedia). For 2001 and 2008 I found no national vote aggregate by nuance in the sources checked (fr.wikipedia pages give only city-by-city results and mayors/seats by family; ministry 2001/2008 national pages for communes >=3,500 were not retrieved) and did not pursue further. Even where available, the series is not a meaningful bloc prior: (1) local labels dominate - in 2014 DVD+DVG+DIV = 50.4% and 'Union de la gauche/droite' lists mix parties; in 2020 'Sans étiquette' alone is 25.9% plus DIV 7.0%, DVD 17.5%, DVG 15.1%, DVC 8.4%, so party/bloc identity is largely erased; (2) nuance attribution rules changed between years (2020 circular, partly suspended by the Conseil d'État, removed nuances for communes <9,000 inhabitants), so years are not comparable; (3) coverage is communes >=1,000 only and many large-city races are uncontested by RN/LFI; (4) 2020 first round was held on 15 March 2020 under COVID with ~42% turnout. Raw tables are included below for audit only; their bloc sums should not be used as a predictor.
